```{r}
library(readr)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
metabric <- read.csv("datatumor3.csv") %>%
  clean_names()
# head(metabric[, 1:5])
```



```{r}

ggplot(metabric, aes(x= type_of_breast_surgery,
                     y= tumor_size)) + geom_boxplot()
```
